gen-dafont-joystix-gf-hedvig-letters-ser: Pure arcade swagger, with Joystix letters spaced far apart and loud. Hedvig Letters Serif brings sturdy, tall lowercase and open curves, so paragraphs of it would read steadily and with some gravity.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-marcellus-sc: Marcellus SC reads dignified and literary, its lowercase standing like cast iron capitals beneath the bold, widely tracked Joystix heading. Give the serif body a little extra size and it settles in nicely.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-esteban: Retro, friendly lettering, with Junegull crossbars fat as the stems. Esteban is the classic serif here, its oversized lowercase and gently varied strokes happy to be sized down a notch.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-glegoo: Friendly is the first word for Lemon Milk, whose loose, wide tracking and rounded letters feel like a rolling-ball pen line. Glegoo, the serif below, gives that roundness an editorial, wide-mouthed partner.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-noticia-text: Lemon Milk sets wide, loosely tracked rounded letters with the texture of neatly bent pipe cleaner, friendly and striking up top. Lemon Milk grabs attention; Noticia Text carries dignified, literary reading.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-scope-one: Lemon Milk draws every curve with one unvarying, rolling-ball line. Lemon Milk is best at striking, friendly display, while Scope One, the traditional serif, handles reading through spilling counters and a big x-height.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-esteban: Light and floaty up top, Nasalization spaces its letters well apart with short ascenders. But Esteban brings the real strength, a refined serif whose slightly thinner joins soften things beside that single-weight line.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-halant: Bent copper pipe made friendly: that is the look of Nasalization. Nasalization is best at floating display lines, while Halant, the classic serif, brings a restrained thick-thin rhythm and a towering x-height.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-hedvig-letter: Smooth, flat-lined and friendly, Nasalization floats its letters well apart across the line. Then Hedvig Letters Serif, tall and sturdy in the lowercase, would carry paragraphs with quiet authority.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-ovo: Friendly, single-nib lettering: that is how Nasalization looks up top. Ovo keeps thin strokes about half the weight of its thick ones, so long paragraphs would read with classic authority.
